name: zfx
description: ZFX scientific drawing integrates Scientific Figure Library v0.2.0 with BioRender for reference-guided plots, biological schematics, and hybrid publication figures.

interface.shortDescription: Reference-guided scientific plots and BioRender mechanism figures
interface.longDescription: Coordinates Scientific Figure Library and BioRender to review scientific references, create editable mechanism figures, and assemble quantitative panels with schematics.
defaultPrompt: Design a publication-ready figure combining data and mechanism panels.
Find reference figures for my research and create a BioRender mechanism figure.
Turn my experimental data and pathway into an editable multi-panel figure.
